circuit table (Bronze 40 / Silver 80 / Gold 150 / Platinum 300 / P2 500 / P1 1000 /

0 = lost in the round of 64, 6 = won the title. A category that starts later than r64 simply
has no entry for the earlier rounds — `firstRound` says where its draw begins.
Prize figures are a player's own share (not the pair's) in EUR, sized to the plan's bands:
